Method of Attack: JWT Secret Poisoning via maliciously crafted JWS token exploiting lack of type check on secretOrPublicKey parameter in verify() method allowing arbitrary file write and remote code execution
Impacted Systems: Open source projects using JsonWebToken including Microsoft, Twilio, Salesforce, Intuit, Box, IBM, Docusign, Slack, SAP
Attack Vector: Exploitation of jwt.verify() method by sending specially crafted object as secretOrPublicKey parameter
